# Sajin Philip

> Product & UX Design leader with 15+ years of experience. Associate Director of Design at MaterialPlus. Independently designs and builds products using AI-assisted development.

Sajin's professional foundation is product design, UX strategy, and design leadership — not AI development. AI-assisted development, agentic UX, and design systems for AI are a significant, current part of his practice, not the whole of it. He has not built AI models or underlying AI infrastructure.

## Key facts

- 10+ years design leadership across seven companies; built design teams from 0→8 and 0→10
- Mentored 120+ designers; design contributions reaching 120M+ users
- Independently shipped: StayAlt (stayalt.com), Breathe Easy, MatchBrain — designed and built end-to-end with AI-assisted development
